subject: science
instructions: Use the supplied investigation, model, or data. Record observations and distinguish evidence from inference.
Follow every safety direction. If required material, adult approval, or a safe alternative is missing, stop.

learnerTasks.prompt: Explain energy from the sun in your own words and give or identify a valid example.
Use a diagram, model, quotation, data display, map, demonstration, or worked process to show understanding of energy in food.
Apply food webs and energy transfer in a new realistic situation. Show the process or cite evidence.
Analyze a plausible error, weak claim, unsafe choice, or design flaw involving gravity; correct it and explain why.
Connect energy from the sun with cause and effect. Explain how the ideas support, constrain, contrast with, or build on one another.
Present the strongest evidence from the unit project: Create a model tracing energy from sunlight through organisms and connect it to observable motion or work.
Identify one skill you can now transfer, one check that improves accuracy or quality, and one next question.

learnerSuccessCriteria: Provide evidence that meets the stated accuracy or fidelity criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated evidence and reasoning criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated application or performance criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated checking and revision criterion.
accommodations: Access supports may change format, pacing, quantity, setting, or response mode without changing the standard being assessed.

provenance.unitObjective: How can the learner demonstrate the goals of Energy in Food and Motion?
